name: Unbreakable keys
description_html:
Update and re-upload of Unbreakable keys

Original description with updated config.jsonc:

Makes keys and keycards unbreakable.

Tired of worrying about the condition of your keys? then this mod is for you!

Contains a configuration with which you can configure it.

{ “weightless_keys”: false, // Removes weight from keys “unbreakable_keys”: true, // Makes keys unbreakable “weightless_keycards”: false, // Removes weight from keycards “unbreakable_keycards”: true, // Makes keycards unbreakable “enable_blacklist”: true, // if true, the options above will not affect the items from the blacklist “blacklisted_items”: [ “5780cf7f2459777de4559322”, // Dorm room 314 marked key “5d80c60f86f77440373c4ece”, // RB-BK marked key “5d80c62a86f7744036212b3f”, // RB-VO marked key “5ede7a8229445733cb4c18e2”, // RB-PKPM marked key “62987dfc402c7f69bf010923”, // Shared bedroom marked key “63a3a93f8a56922e82001f5d”, // Abandoned factory marked key “64ccc25f95763a1ae376e447”, // Mysterious room marked key “5448ba0b4bdc2d02308b456c”, // Factory emergency exit key “593962ca86f774068014d9af”, // Unknown key “5937ee6486f77408994ba448”, // Machinery key “64d4b23dc1b37504b41ac2b6”, // Rusted bloody key “63a39e1d234195315d4020bd”, // Primorsky 46-48 skybridge key “5c94bbff86f7747ee735c08f” // TerraGroup Labs access keycard ] } It makes keys and key cards unbreakable so you can use them endlessly.
